_doc: The D7 campaign survey — items 1, 3 and 4. Items 2 and 6 (the five-width vLLM matrices at 475 tokens) are calibrate.py --phase ramp --tokens 475; item 5 (sleep) is calibrate.py --phase sleep. Every digest here was verified on the live hosts during step 0.2 on 2026-08-19; `placement.observed_2026_08_19` is what that step MEASURED, so a campaign reading can be compared against a number rather than against an intuition.
_host_affinity: E6: an entry runs only on the hosts it names. The roster is 5 models on srv1 and 10 on srv2, which a full host-by-entry cross-product could not express — srv1's 6144 MiB card cannot hold the five large models, and running them there would produce five refusals that mean nothing.
_placement: D4: MIN_VRAM_FRACTION is withdrawn as a global gate. `min_vram_fraction` here is a per-entry DECLARATION and is present only where a floor is a real expectation. The two MoE models that the old 0.8 gate refused carry NO floor: a MoE serving part of its bytes off-card is working as designed, and `gpt-oss:20b` at 0.794 — the refusal the entire finding was built around — was never a failure.

models.label: qwen2.5-coder-7b
models._doc: local-ai encodes a hard pool rule `never_7b_on_srv1` — 4.7 GB plus its KV cache does not fit 6144 MiB. That is a SERVING-TIER decision and this is a calibration campaign: the spill is the data point, and it is the only partial-offload point srv1 offers. Measured 0.908 on srv1 against 1.0 on srv2 — the same weights, two placements, which is D4's whole argument in one entry.

models.label: nemotron-3-nano-4b
models._doc: A REASONING model, measured on both rigs: ~69% of its output budget is hidden `thinking` (54 eval_count for a 17-token visible reply). Its throughput is real throughput, but `completion_tokens` counts reasoning tokens, so the number is not comparable with a non-reasoning model's visible-token rate. Also the one model whose child overrides OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL: total_slots reads 1 on srv1 where every other model reads 2.

models.label: llama3.2-3b
models._doc: Provisioned onto srv2 in step 0.2 by `ollama pull` and verified byte-identical to srv1's copy — the digests match, so the mutable-tag risk this pin exists for did not fire.

models.label: qwen2.5-coder-14b
models._doc: D7 item 3, the DENSE half of the sharpest MoE/dense pair: similar bytes to gpt-oss:20b, very different active parameters. Measured fully resident at 1.0 on srv2's 12 GB card at 4096 context — the brief expected a spill and there is none, which is itself the contrast.

models.label: yi-coder-9b
models._doc: D7 item 3, the second dense comparator.

models.label: deepseek-coder-v2-16b
models._doc: MoE (~16B total against ~2.4B active) and yet fully resident at 1.0 — the case that makes the point most sharply: architecture alone does not predict placement, so a placement gate cannot be read as an architecture check.

models.label: gpt-oss-20b
models._doc: THE model D4 was decided about. It read 0.794 and the withdrawn 0.8 gate refused it as unmeasurable; it is a MoE and was never failing. No floor is declared here — that is the decision, expressed. Also a reasoning model: ~72% of its output budget went to hidden reasoning on the readiness probe, heavier than the ~52% on record.

models.label: qwen3-coder-30b
models._doc: The deepest spill on the roster at 0.581 — 19.2 GB against a 12 GB card. No floor, same reason as gpt-oss:20b. Do not confuse with the off-roster `qwen3:30b-a3b` (pulled as F16, not Q4) or `qwen3-coder-next-ud:q3_K_XL` (36 GB, swaps, and has a reproducible CUDA fault on this host); both sit next to it in `ollama list`, which is why this is pinned by digest.

models.label: coresident-3b-beside-1.5b
models._doc: D7 item 4 — INTENDED co-residency. The 1.5B is loaded first and stays resident, then the 3B lands beside it; placement is captured for the pair and the ramp runs with the neighbour up. Before this rewrite `claim` required `resident_names == [model]`, so this step was refused by construction: the harness could not express the thing the decision asked it to measure.

observed_2026_08_19.note: solo readings were 1.0 on both hosts; this entry measures whether sharing changes that
